claims.evidence: Witness photos show a blue cast industrial unit with flanged/cylindrical housings and mounting base, consistent with a gear reducer/gearbox form factor.
No readable nameplate/markings or rating plate is shown in the witness report.
Photos do not show provenance documents, shipping marks, or readable labels confirming Belgium origin.
Witness report only describes visible external features; no running video, sound/vibration evidence, or leak test is shown.
No clip/video of operation or mechanical sound check is included in the witness report.
No service hours/mileage meter or internal inspection evidence is shown.
No seal/fastener tamper evidence or internal view is shown; photos do not confirm whether it has been opened.

risks.risk: Exact model/gear ratio and compatibility (hp rating, input/output speed, shaft type) cannot be confirmed from the photos; wrong unit could be unusable for the buyer’s machine.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the nameplate/label with model number, gear ratio, input/output RPM, shaft details, and any motor coupling specs (or a short video panning across the label).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unverified gear reducer with unknown ratio/specs (worst-case compatibility risk).

risks.risk: Working condition is not proven (could be seized, noisy under load, leaking oil, or damaged bearings/seals).
risks.proof: A short video of it running under load (or at least a no-load run) showing smooth rotation, no abnormal noise, and no oil leaks around seals/flanges.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: needs servicing/possible overhaul).

risks.risk: The yellow end/shaft area may be a coupling, protective cover, or a specific shaft extension; condition and exact part type affect fit and safety.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the yellow part showing whether it is a coupling/shaft/protective cover, plus a measurement of shaft diameter and keyway/spline details.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming unknown/possibly incomplete or mismatched coupling/shaft interface.

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (oil level plug, breather, mounting hardware, output flange adapter, guards) could prevent installation.
risks.proof: Photos of all sides including mounting faces, any ports/plugs, and a checklist of included accessories/hardware (with a photo of the box/bag of bolts if included).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially missing installation hardware/accessories.

risks.risk: Physical condition (cracks, dents, corrosion, damaged flanges/bearings) cannot be fully assessed from the limited angles.
risks.proof: High-resolution close-ups of the flanges, bolt holes, housing seams, and any visible wear/corrosion spots; include a straight-on shot of each end.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case external wear/possible damage requiring inspection.

proof_requests: Send a clear, readable photo of the nameplate/label (model, gear ratio, input/output RPM, shaft type, and any hp/kW rating).
Send a short video of the unit running (no-load at minimum) showing smooth operation and no abnormal noise.
Send close-up photos of the yellow end area to confirm whether it is a coupling/shaft/protective cover, including shaft diameter and keyway/spline details.
Send photos of all ports/plugs (oil fill/drain, breather) and confirm whether any parts are missing.
Send close-ups of flanges, bolt holes, and housing seams for cracks/corrosion, plus a photo showing mounting hardware included (if any).
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a cast industrial gearbox/reducer-like unit, but the critical pricing drivers (exact model/ratio/specs and verified working condition) are not readable or proven in the report. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
